items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: And I played a few engagements on drums with Professor Claiborne William of Donnisonville, St. Joseph Band at that time.

ctx.x: January the 25th. Was there a particular time? Was it in the country? In the country, yeah. I fought on the rice farm there. Still on it. And I came up on the rice farm. And I was a man who played the violins at the end of eight years. I was bringing my music for it when I was eager to work. And I started playing professional around New Orleans, ballrooms, and parks, street parades, drums. And I played with a little brass band around a place called Jamestown in Louisiana, what they call the Beehive Brass Band.…
